title: Managed Database: primary per-node reconciliation applicability
content:
## Applicable business situation
Managed Database primary per-node reconciliation is governed by these scope conditions. The linked resource count must be a positive integer within the database tier maximum resource count, and measured node-hours must fit the resource count and the actual source month. The approved negotiated rate for this route must be nonnegative and no greater than the standard tier unit rate; higher negotiated rates retain ordinary source-based correction handling. This signed credit workflow applies only when the reconstructed corrected gross target is strictly less than the original gross charge plus cumulative signed correction credits and debit adjustments for that exact source. Determine this comparison from the source evidence before selecting the workflow. Undercharges use the inherited positive-debit correction rule and equal corrected balances use its no-write rule; neither is handled by this credit workflow. This consolidated primary-export route applies where archive quantities are whole hundredths of a node-hour; finer export quantities retain the ordinary source-meter route. This branch handles a requested correction of one closed-period primary invoice for an on-demand, nonpromotional database contract below the portfolio threshold, with reviewed verified exempt tax treatment and a single active Managed Backup holding for the same customer and billing entity. The signed linked topology and the original source invoice both record the same resource count; all selected export records use that source and count. The historical source tier and configuration must match the current database contract. No other invoice line is included and no refund is implicit.
